errors.evidence: The description states the value for 2016 is 'около 0%' (around 0%), but the plot shows a value clearly above zero, at approximately 0.2%. This is inconsistent with the description for the 2014 value, which has the same Y-coordinate and was correctly described as 'приблизително 0,2%' (approximately 0.2%).
